steps.speaker: Local
steps.content: DisCity... you said DisCity...
At the mere mention of DisCity, a spark of hope ignites as he staggers to his feet.

steps.speaker: Local
steps.content: Has DisCity sent help to us?!
Others emerge cautiously from hiding. They were wary just now seeing you fought off the monsters, but now they begin gathering upon hearing his cries of DisCity.

steps.speaker: Zindy
steps.content: DisCity has sent help! We're saved!

steps.speaker: Local
steps.content: Did Miss Vautour Bleu send you? I knew she'd come through for us! She wasn't lying. She'd never abandon us!
The townsfolk's eyes cling to you as if you're the only thread they can grasp.
...Head to the inn in the town center immediately. There's a safe zone set up there.
You cannot but dodge their questions. Yes, Vautour Bleu did send you, but they can't know that.
It's part of the deal you've made.
[Edge of town]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you hearing yourself? Provoking the townsfolk, draining their emotions, and channeling all this Mania... Once you start, there's no stopping it. If you can't hold the contamination, you'll end up a monster like those.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You call this a deal? It's a gamble, and a terrible one.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I'm afraid this is a deal you cannot turn down. Because... it's already started.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, you'll go through with it anyways, right? You're banking on me to protect them, betting that I'm not like the Outland Affairs Bureau, that I won't abandon them. And you don't care about your own safety, about whether my shackles could hold you back from degradation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How on earth did your caravan even get to its scale? Trading yourself for the safety of the whole town, that's the worst deal I've ever heard.
Sensing your mood, Vautour Bleu brushes the dust off your coat with feigned ease and gives your shoulder a reassuring pat.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Well, thank goodness you're here.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Right now, the datura growth can only keep a small area safe—in the town center, around the inn.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I'll guide as many people there as I can. The monsters will be swarming outside of it.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: And my dear neighbor, I need you to make a dashing entrance just at the perfect time, saving them from despair in the name of DisCity.
You're retreating with us. Don't even think about staging some heroic self-sacrifice. You still need to explain yourself to these people. There's no escaping that.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Explain myself? There's nothing to explain. I did this. I brought them here and deceived them. I'm trapping them in this utopia, feeding them empty promises.
From the town center, the sounds of panic and commotion grow louder, mingled with the clashing cries and the shrieks of monsters.
The hunt for Vautour Bleu has begun.
